tools.description: Change only the ProxyJump directive in one target alias in the disposable SSH client's config. It preserves all other lines and is reversible. Choose only after observing a connectivity problem.

tools.name: append_client_public_key
tools.description: Append the SSH client's public key to one lab server's authorized_keys without replacing or removing existing entries. It is a no-op if that key is already present, and reports before/after hashes and whether all previous bytes were preserved.

tools.name: add_permit_open_destination
tools.description: Add one specific host:port to a lab server's existing SSH PermitOpen allowlist. Existing destinations and all other configuration lines are preserved; sshd_config is validated and reloaded without restarting the container.

tools.name: enable_client_key_port_forwarding
tools.description: Enable TCP port forwarding for the client's existing public-key entry in one server's authorized_keys. It changes only that entry's option field, preserving the key, comments, other lines, file owner, and mode.

tools.name: remove_client_key_forced_command
tools.description: Remove only a command= restriction from the client's existing public-key entry on one lab server. The key, comments, any other key options, other entries, file owner, and file mode are preserved.
